questions.q: Where is the Financial Reporting Center located in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials?
options: It is a standalone application separate from Oracle Fusion
Inside the General Accounting work area
Only inside Microsoft Excel via Smart View
Inside the Scheduled Processes work area
questions.explain: The Financial Reporting Center is opened from inside the General Accounting work area, typically via a Navigator task.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT something the Financial Reporting Center brings together on one page?
options: Financial Reporting Web Studio statements
Account Groups with Sunburst visualization
Smart View reports and OTBI/BI Publisher content
Employee payroll setup screens
questions.explain: Payroll setup is not reporting content; the Financial Reporting Center brings together FR Studio statements, Account Groups, Smart View reports, OTBI content, and BI Publisher reports.

questions.q: What is the typical difference between "running" and "authoring" content in the Financial Reporting Center?
options: There is no difference; both terms mean the same thing
Running means picking a point of view and viewing/exporting a result; authoring means building new content in the FR Web Studio editor
Authoring can only happen inside Smart View
Running requires administrator access; authoring requires none
questions.explain: Running existing content typically involves selecting a point of view like ledger, period, and scenario, while authoring new Financial Reporting Studio content happens in a separate editor.

questions.q: What visualization tool is specifically associated with Account Groups in the Financial Reporting Center?
options: Pivot table
Sunburst
Gantt chart
Scatter plot
questions.explain: Account Groups are displayed in the Financial Reporting Center using the Sunburst visualization tool.

questions.q: Why is the Financial Reporting Center often the first place a consultant points a client who says "I just need my monthly financials"?
options: Because it is the only tool available in Oracle Fusion
Because it gathers statements, trial balance, and account groups in one place without needing to explain four separate tools
Because it requires no security access of any kind
Because it replaces the need for the General Ledger entirely
questions.explain: The Financial Reporting Center acts as a front door that surfaces the most commonly needed financial reporting content in one place.
